svg.text: Crafting turtle: where to put it
+ wireless or ender modem on its other side
the crafter chest: directly in front
full-block wired modem touching the chest
(not between the chest and the turtle)
or: a full-block wired modem against its back
on the storage cable, instead of wireless
• It finds its own chest: nothing to pick in 'storage setup'.
• Far away, with a craft overseer hub: its barrel goes on the overseer's cable instead, and the turtle needs an ender modem.
